content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2 (concentrated peak overtime + chat deflection, ₹10,044), but involve the duty manager: it is predicted to reach only 65.7% for 12:00-14:00, short of the 80% target and below the 70% escalation line.","why":"Calls on general are taking much longer (646 s at 10:00 against about 350–376 s forecast). The cause appears to be the P2 CRM incident INC-20261021-5862, which has customer search taking 20–40 seconds. Volume and staffing are close to plan, so the problem is slower calls, not more calls or fewer agents. R2 offers overtime to 24 general and 14 payments agents from 12:30 to 14:00, and deflects 20% of simple enquiries to chat from 12:00 to 14:30. It gives the best predicted service level of any option: 65.7% overall (general 61.4%, payments 69.1%), with abandons at 11.9%. Doing nothing gives 30.6% and 22.9% abandons. Rest of day is predicted at 86.6% with R2.","trade_offs":["P3 (₹11,484) costs ₹1,440 more for slightly less overall (64.9%) and lower general (58.4%). It does edge R2 on payments (69.9% vs 69.1%), abandons (10.5% vs 11.9%) and rest of day (87.8% vs 86.6%), and it relies on break delays and callbacks.","R1 (₹9,324) and P4 (₹10,080) are similar in cost but weaker: 58.9% and 53.3%.","The no-cost plans fall well short: P1 reaches 20.8% and P2 38.5% (₹1,404).","General stays the weaker queue under R2 at 61.4%, against 69.1% on payments. Neither queue is protected at the other's expense, but both are below target."],"watch":"Escalate now: no plan reaches the 70% line (ESC-02), so the duty manager should decide on further steps, such as pushing for a faster fix to the CRM incident or extra resourcing. Track overtime take-up, since R2 depends on enough of the 38 offers being accepted. Watch handle time on general as the incident progresses: if CRM search recovers, the overtime may be scaled back, and if it worsens, results will fall below the forecast."}
